senses.definition: to take or bring someone or something along
to carry or have something with one

examples.sentence: 黄巾军的程远志带人来攻涿郡。
刘备带关羽、张飞去迎敌。
三人带人赶到青州，发现敌人很多。
关羽和张飞各带一部分人，藏在山的两边。
第二天，刘备带人向前打。
后来，商人带着一群马来到张飞家。
不久，程远志带五万人来打涿郡。
刘焉让邹靖带刘备、关羽、张飞和五百人出发。
”刘焉让邹靖带五千人同行。
刘备让关羽带一千人到山左，张飞带一千人到山右，在那里埋伏，以鸣金为号。
”于是邹靖带兵回去，刘备、关羽、张飞带五百人前往卢植那里。
你带人去看看那里的情况，回来告诉我。
张梁、张宝只好带着剩下的人拼命逃走。
张角带兵将要进攻幽州。
于是有人来报，两个客人带着伙伴和一群马来到庄上。
邹靖带他们见刘焉，刘焉认刘备为侄子。
刘焉让邹靖带刘备、张飞、关羽三人，领五百人前去迎敌。
”于是，邹靖带五千人，和刘备、关羽、张飞一起出发。
”他让关羽带一千人埋伏在山左，张飞带一千人埋伏在山右，听到信号就出来帮助。
龚景又带乡勇出城相助，青州之围终于解开。
他和关羽、张飞带五百人赶往广宗。
卢植让刘备带本部人马，再带一千官军到颍川，联络皇甫嵩、朱隽，约好时间一起进攻。
卢植让刘备带本部人马，再带一千官军到颍川，联络皇甫嵩、朱隽，约好时间一起进攻。
皇甫嵩、朱隽商量后，决定火攻，命士兵各带一把草，暗中埋下伏兵。
二更后，伏兵一齐放火，两人各带军队攻入营中。
战到天明，张梁、张宝带残兵逃走。
黄巾军起兵后，曹操带着五千名士兵赶到颍川。
曹操见过皇甫嵩和朱隽，便带兵继续追击张梁、张宝。
一次，有人夜里带刀走路，曹操把他抓住，按禁令用木棒责罚。
刘备带着关羽、张飞赶到颍川时，只听见喊杀声，也看见火光照亮天空。
他急忙带兵赶去，却发现黄巾军已经败散，战事已经结束。
刘备带兵回去，半路遇见护送囚车的军队，车里是卢植。
刘备认出是张角，马上带关羽、张飞冲下山。

previous.explanation_en: 带 means to take or bring someone along as you move or act. It can also mean to lead or guide a group when directing them is emphasized. The word itself does not specify the direction of movement; context determines whether “take” or “bring” fits.
previous.caveat_en: The emphasis on accompanying people versus directing them depends on context; the word does not always force a sharp distinction.

parts.contribution_en: As a whole word, means to take or bring someone along, and can mean to lead or guide a group when directing them is emphasized.

sources.title: 帶 — Ministry of Education Concised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary
sources.summary_en: Lists 帶 as both carrying or holding something with oneself and leading or guiding, with 帶路 and 帶頭 as examples of the latter. These are separate modern senses; the entry does not explain their historical relationship.

sources.title: 帶 — Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary
sources.summary_en: Lists senses including carrying or holding something with oneself and leading or guiding. It gives object examples for carrying and compounds such as 帶兵, 帶路, 帶隊, and 帶頭 for leading. It also cites the older concrete belt or sash sense, without tracing a semantic path between these senses.

sources.title: 帶同 — Ministry of Education Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary
sources.summary_en: Defines 帶同 as 帶領同來 and cites a passage in which 晁蓋 and 公孫勝 go to 石碣村 帶同十數個莊客. This supports a people-accompanying use while retaining the dictionary's leading wording.

sources.title: 说文解字/07 — Wikisource
sources.summary_en: The Shuowen entry defines 带 as 绅 and describes it as an item worn and tied. This attests an older belt or sash sense, but does not establish that the modern use with people developed from it.

claims.text_en: In the supplied examples, 带 connects someone with a person or group accompanying them in movement or action. Depending on the clause, English may render this as take or bring; the word itself does not determine the direction. The dictionary entry for 帶同 supports a people-accompanying use, though its definition also uses the wording “lead them to come along.”

带 also has a dictionary sense of leading or guiding. This supports lead when the context foregrounds directing a group, as in 带人向前打. It does not require treating every supplied instance as formal command: 带人来攻 and 带关羽、张飞去迎敌 can be understood as taking people along, with leading possible when direction is foregrounded.

The sources attest an older belt or sash sense and separately list carrying and leading senses. They do not demonstrate that taking or bringing people along derives from the belt or sash sense, so that semantic history remains unresolved.

gaps: The opened references support the modern carrying/accompanying and leading readings, but do not establish a semantic path from the older belt or sash sense to either use with people.
The sources do not define a precise boundary between taking people along and leading them in each supplied sentence; the available 帶同 definition itself combines accompanying with leading wording.
